metadata.description: Java OS user-mode test executable - freestanding x86_64, fixed load address (non-PIE). SSE/SSE2/SSE3/SSSE3/SSE4.x enabled since change kernel-fpu-context-switch (FXSAVE/FXRSTOR per thread on context switch, see kernel::fpu) - float/double usable. AVX/AVX2 remain disabled (would need XSAVE, wider than the legacy FXSAVE area) and MMX remains disabled (legacy, unused).
